SELECT
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN '采购单' WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN '销售单' WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN '采购退货单' WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN '销售退货单' WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN '调拨单-出' WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN '调拨单-入' WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN '其它入库单' WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN '其它出库单' ELSE bi.type END as type,
bi.direction as direction,
bi.nums as nums,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(b.time) WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(s.time) WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(br.time) WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(sr.time) WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(sw.time) WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(sw.time) WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(e.time) WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(ex.time) ELSE NOW() END as "costData.time",
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN b.id WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN s.id WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN br.id WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sr.id WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN sw.id WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN sw.id WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN e.id WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN ex.id ELSE NULL END as "costData.id",
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN b.number WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN s.number WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN br.number WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sr.number WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN sw.number WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN sw.number WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN e.number WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN ex.number ELSE '' END as "costData.number",
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN f_b.id WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN f_s.id WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN f_br.id WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN f_sr.id WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN f_sw.id WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN f_sw.id WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN f_e.id WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN f_ex.id ELSE NULL END as "costData.frameData.id",
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN f_b.name WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN f_s.name WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN f_br.name WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN f_sr.name WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN f_sw.name WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN f_sw.name WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN f_e.name WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN f_ex.name ELSE '' END as "costData.frameData.name"
FROM is_batch_info bi
LEFT JOIN is_buy_info bi_buy ON bi.type = 'buy' AND bi.info = bi_buy.id LEFT JOIN is_sell_info bi_sell ON bi.type = 'sell' AND bi.info = bi_sell.id LEFT JOIN is_bre_info bi_bre ON bi.type = 'bre' AND bi.info = bi_bre.id LEFT JOIN is_sre_info bi_sre ON bi.type = 'sre' AND bi.info = bi_sre.id LEFT JOIN is_swap_info bi_swap ON (bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter') AND bi.info = bi_swap.id LEFT JOIN is_entry_info bi_entry ON bi.type = 'entry' AND bi.info = bi_entry.id LEFT JOIN is_extry_info bi_extry ON bi.type = 'extry' AND bi.info = bi_extry.id
LEFT JOIN is_buy b ON bi.type = 'buy' AND bi.class = b.id LEFT JOIN is_frame f_b ON b.frame = f_b.id
LEFT JOIN is_sell s ON bi.type = 'sell' AND bi.class = s.id LEFT JOIN is_frame f_s ON s.frame = f_s.id
LEFT JOIN is_bre br ON bi.type = 'bre' AND bi.class = br.id LEFT JOIN is_frame f_br ON br.frame = f_br.id
LEFT JOIN is_sre sr ON bi.type = 'sre' AND bi.class = sr.id LEFT JOIN is_frame f_sr ON sr.frame = f_sr.id
LEFT JOIN is_swap sw ON (bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter') AND bi.class = sw.id LEFT JOIN is_frame f_sw ON sw.frame = f_sw.id
LEFT JOIN is_entry e ON bi.type = 'entry' AND bi.class = e.id LEFT JOIN is_frame f_e ON e.frame = f_e.id
LEFT JOIN is_extry ex ON bi.type = 'extry' AND bi.class = ex.id LEFT JOIN is_frame f_ex ON ex.frame = f_ex.id
AND ( (bi.type = 'buy' AND bi_buy.goods = #{query.goodsId}) OR (bi.type = 'sell' AND bi_sell.goods = #{query.goodsId}) OR (bi.type = 'bre' AND bi_bre.goods = #{query.goodsId}) OR (bi.type = 'sre' AND bi_sre.goods = #{query.goodsId}) OR ((bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter') AND bi_swap.goods = #{query.goodsId}) OR (bi.type = 'entry' AND bi_entry.goods = #{query.goodsId}) OR (bi.type = 'extry' AND bi_extry.goods = #{query.goodsId}) )
AND ( (bi.type = 'buy' AND bi_buy.attr = #{query.attrName}) OR (bi.type = 'sell' AND bi_sell.attr = #{query.attrName}) OR (bi.type = 'bre' AND bi_bre.attr = #{query.attrName}) OR (bi.type = 'sre' AND bi_sre.attr = #{query.attrName}) OR ((bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter') AND bi_swap.attr = #{query.attrName}) OR (bi.type = 'entry' AND bi_entry.attr = #{query.attrName}) OR (bi.type = 'extry' AND bi_extry.attr = #{query.attrName}) )
AND bi.type IN
#{type}
AND ( (bi.type = 'buy' AND b.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%')) OR (bi.type = 'sell' AND s.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%')) OR (bi.type = 'bre' AND br.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%')) OR (bi.type = 'sre' AND sr.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%')) OR ((bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter') AND sw.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%')) OR (bi.type = 'entry' AND e.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%')) OR (bi.type = 'extry' AND ex.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.documentNumber}, '%')) )
AND ( (bi.type = 'buy' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.time) >= #{query.startDate}) OR (bi.type = 'sell' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(s.time) >= #{query.startDate}) OR (bi.type = 'bre' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(br.time) >= #{query.startDate}) OR (bi.type = 'sre' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(sr.time) >= #{query.startDate}) OR ((bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter') AND FROM_UNIXTIME(sw.time) >= #{query.startDate}) OR (bi.type = 'entry' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(e.time) >= #{query.startDate}) OR (bi.type = 'extry' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(ex.time) >= #{query.startDate}) )
AND ( (bi.type = 'buy' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.time) <= #{query.endDate}) OR (bi.type = 'sell' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(s.time) <= #{query.endDate}) OR (bi.type = 'bre' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(br.time) <= #{query.endDate}) OR (bi.type = 'sre' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(sr.time) <= #{query.endDate}) OR ((bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter') AND FROM_UNIXTIME(sw.time) <= #{query.endDate}) OR (bi.type = 'entry' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(e.time) <= #{query.endDate}) OR (bi.type = 'extry' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(ex.time) <= #{query.endDate}) )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN b.time WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN s.time WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN br.time WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN sr.time WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN sw.time WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN sw.time WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN e.time WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN ex.time ELSE 0 END DESC

SELECT ri.time AS time,
CASE WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN '采购单' WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN '销售单' WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN '采购退货单' WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN '销售退货单' WHEN ri.type = 'swap' THEN '调拨单' WHEN ri.type = 'swapEnter' THEN '调拨单-入' WHEN ri.type = 'swapOut' THEN '调拨单-出' WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN '其它入库单' WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN '其它出库单' ELSE ri.type END AS type,
CASE WHEN ri.type = 'entry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_entry WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'extry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_extry WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'buy' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_buy WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'sell' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sell WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'bre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_bre WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'sre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sre WHERE id = ri.class) WHEN ri.type = 'swap' OR ri.type = 'swapEnter' OR ri.type = 'swapOut' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_swap WHERE id = ri.class) END AS number,
CASE WHEN ri.direction = 0 THEN '减少' WHEN ri.direction = 1 THEN '增加' ELSE CAST(ri.direction AS CHAR) END AS direction, CAST(ri.nums AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS nums FROM is_room_info ri INNER JOIN is_room r ON ri.pid = r.id WHERE r.goods = #{id} ORDER BY ri.time DESC
